en.quote: For what portion of God is there from above? and what inheritance of the Almighty from on high?
en.riddle: For what portion of God is there from above? and what inheritance of the Almighty from on high?
en.speaker: Job

he.quote: וּמֶה חֵלֶק אֱלוֹהַּ מִמָּעַל וְֽנַחֲלַת שַׁדַּי מִמְּרֹמִֽים
he.riddle: וּמֶה חֵלֶק אֱלוֹהַּ מִמָּעַל וְֽנַחֲלַת שַׁדַּי מִמְּרֹמִֽים
